Intentionally a shared chart-primitive hub; a follow-up pass should split the static-axis/skeleton primitives, the sync-context brush, and the data-table accessibility layer into sibling modules.

Split verb execution and result assembly into focused hooks before adding more palette modes.

Split cohort-baseline derivation and selection orchestration into hooks in a follow-up compare cleanup pass.

src/components/stablecoin-table.tsx.notes: Design Council Wave 2/9 added the geometry-matched skeleton, View-Transition sort wrapping, the j/k row cursor + numeric-sort listener, and the background RefreshingBar to the virtualized home table. src/components/tape/event-card.tsx.notes: Surfaced after the projector module batch (PSI/DEWS/mint-burn/yield) widened per-event-class rendering. Split per-event-class card families in a follow-up tape UI pass once the event taxonomy stabilizes.

src/app/yield/client.tsx.notes: Surfaced after Yield v8.13 added the preset-chip handlers, story-callout derivation, currency-tab integration, and trending filter wiring alongside the existing trust rail + scatter plot. Split story-callout derivation and preset-handler plumbing into focused hooks in the next yield UI cleanup pass.

shared/lib/selector/engine.ts.notes: Selector engine owns exclusions, scoring, confidence redistribution, evidence selection, lower-ranked assembly, and output shaping for the MVP. src/app/screener/picker/client.tsx.notes: Selector client still coordinates wizard history, query hydration, data loading, snapshot fetch/post, and result rendering. This remediation extracted dataset adaptation, but the route shell remains a hotspot; split snapshot lifecycle and wizard orchestration hooks before adding more selector UI modes.

src/components/status/cron-metadata-summ.notes: Status metadata summarization has grown with the ops dashboard. Defer structural cleanup until the status surface settles after the current parallel work.

worker/src/cron/weekly-recap.ts.notes: Weekly recap input assembly grew with week-over-week deltas, weekly signal leaderboards, and split parse-row plumbing. Keep waived until the digest prompt rewrite stabilizes; a follow-up pass should extract aggregation vs. prompt rendering into separate modules.

worker/src/api/telegram-webhook.ts.notes: Webhook ingress still coordinates transport validation, pending-state dispatch, command routing, and update lifecycle marking. Keep explicitly waived for this remediation branch; the next Telegram decomposition pass should move the pending-owner command clearing branch into a narrower dispatcher helper.

src/app/pharoswatchbot/page.tsx.notes: Static product landing page grew with the How-It-Works section, DEWS bands explainer, and JSON-LD block added in the 2026-04-17 telegram bot comprehensive audit. worker/src/cron/confirm-pending-depegs.t.notes: Phase 2 added the evaluateOffchainConfirmer discriminated union to flatten the 9-level branch tree. Residual height is in the main loop's structural orchestration (primary/native/DEX/CEX/pool collection). Next /simplify pass should extract buildConfirmationPlan and evaluatePromotionDecision.

src/components/homepage-client.tsx.notes: Surfaced after global shell and homepage runtime reductions. The homepage client still coordinates hero state, PSI/digest/table sections, mode controls, and multiple lightweight data views; split section orchestration and interaction state before expanding the homepage surface.

src/app/timeline/client.tsx.notes: Timeline client combines URL filters, pagination, feed hydration, summary-band controls, and tape render plumbing in one shell. A follow-up refactor should split control orchestration from data orchestration before adding another feature tranche.

src/lib/yield-view-model.ts.notes: Yield view model assembly grew with score breakdown, source-risk projection, and warning aggregation. Surfaced after global LOC budget tightening; split score derivation vs. row shaping in a follow-up yield UI pass.

worker/src/cron/yield-sync/publication.t.notes: Yield publication now owns source arbitration output shaping, decision evidence persistence, atomic publication metadata, and alternative-source projection for v8 decision ledgers. Keep waived for this rollout; split decision persistence and ranking row projection into narrower modules in the next yield-sync cleanup.

src/components/key-info-card.tsx.notes: Surfaced after the May 2026 detail-page additions: mechanism schematic above peg-stability prose, tier-styled attestor badge with legacy fallback, and the matching utility helpers. Split mechanism-diagram renderer + attestor badge + peg-mechanism prose into focused children in a follow-up detail-page cleanup pass.

src/app/sitemap.ts.notes: Next.js static-export sitemap concatenates fixed-route, dynamic-route, taxonomy, methodology-changelog, feed, depeg-event, and dataset segments inside a single function so the regex-typed `MetadataRoute.Sitemap` return value is inferable end-to-end. Council-13 (W2-E/W3-D/W3-G) added the feed, depeg-event, and dataset segments. Splitting into helpers is queued for a future sitemap-builder refactor; the current shape is the most idiomatic Next 16 pattern.
